cenas.editar: Photorealistic full-frame photo, 9:16 vertical. No phone frame, no device bezel, no borders, no added text. Top-down DSLR photo filling the entire frame edge to edge: one open plain white quilted dog training pad with a thin pale blue border lying flat on a light wood floor, centered between 30% and 60% of the image height, with blue liquid being absorbed in its center. No bag or packaging anywhere, no text, no letters, no logos, no printing on the pad or anywhere in the image.
cenas.movimento: Very slow overhead push-in; the blue liquid sinks into the pad and the stain shrinks until the surface looks dry.

cenas.cta: Toque no carrinho e leve o seu
